messages.subject: Project Onyx - term sheet comments
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Rohan,

We've reviewed the Calderbrook term sheet. A few points before you sign:

1. Exclusivity is 45 days - reasonable, but binding.
2. The option pool top-up to 10 per cent is created pre-money, so it dilutes you and not the incoming investors. Please confirm you're comfortable.
3. The Lead Investor cost cap of £75k plus VAT is payable even on a failure to complete attributable to you - we'd push to make it payable only on completion.
4. The 1x non-participating preference is market for this stage.

Happy to call tomorrow.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
